summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the extension of a time charter contract for its Post-Panamax vessel m/v Polymnia with Oldendorff Carriers. The gross charter rate is $20,000 per day minus a 5% commission, with a period from minimum March 1, 2027 to maximum April 30, 2027, commencing June 1, 2026. This is a routine commercial contract extension in the ordinary course of business for a shipping company, not a special situation event. No special situation attributes apply. The filing provides no special-situation terms.
